meta.title: Anupam Sarkar — Design Leader, Enterprise UX & AI
meta.description: Anupam Sarkar — design leader working on enterprise platforms and AI-augmented design. Case studies: Smart Mining, Falcon View, Incident Management for Microsoft Teams, BT Business Billing.

hero.statement: I take enterprise systems that nobody can read — billing portals, mine control rooms, hospital operations, incident response — and turn them into a decision someone can make before the shift ends. Currently leading UX strategy for IBM Power Systems, and building AI-augmented design practice along the way.

philosophy.heading: Design for the decision, not the screen.
philosophy.lede: Thirteen years across IBM, BT Group, Siemens and John Deere taught me one thing repeatedly: enterprise software rarely fails on aesthetics. It fails because the person who has to act can't find the thing they need to act on.

tenets.title: Start from intent, work backwards to interface
tenets.body: Before any wireframe I map what the user is actually trying to settle — the alert they must triage, the dispute they must close, the shift they must hand over. Layout follows from that. It's why supervisors scan Where → Who before Severity, and why the designs I ship put location first.

tenets.title: Compress the cycle, never the evidence
tenets.body: I use AI to do the slow parts faster — coding interview transcripts, drafting documentation, generating prototype variants — so the team spends its hours on judgement instead of transcription. 147 field observations, coded and affinity-grouped in a fraction of the usual time, with the audit trail left visible for whoever challenges the number.

tenets.title: Governance is a set of agreements, not a gate
tenets.body: A design system only holds if the people shipping against it agreed to it. I run 3-in-a-box — PM, engineering and design deciding together — and write the rules down at token level so drift is a diff, not an argument.

philosophy.kicker: Less rework. Higher velocity. Impact you can put a number on.

experience.heading: Where I've led.
experience.lede: Five organisations, one recurring job: arrive where the complexity lives, set the design direction, and leave a team that can hold it without me.

items.body: UX strategy for hardware and platform tooling used by 10,000+ enterprise users. Scaled the Carbon Design System across squads, introduced 3-in-a-box governance, and cut UI drift by 20% — first-pass design approvals up 35%.

Directed UX strategy for global billing and provisioning platforms serving 340,000+ businesses and 500,000 users. Reframed a portal redesign as a system fix, and halved feature-discovery cycles from 4 weeks to 2.
Set the design vision for sustainability and workforce dashboards used across 190+ countries. Made evidence-based design the default: prototype validation success rose from 60% to 85%.
Digital strategy across immersive XR and virtual showrooms for the Asia market — reducing dependency on physical demos by 40% while keeping the dealer conversation intact.
Led 30+ MVP engagements for enterprise collaboration platforms, and built the team's first AI-in-the-loop research and prototyping workflows.

works.heading: Four systems, start to shipped.
works.lede: Each case study opens in full — problem, research, the calls I made, and what changed afterwards. All four carry a dark/light switch in the top-right corner, and it remembers your choice across the site.
works.shelfLabel: Also on the shelf — models I reuse

frames.title: Intent-First UX (IFU)
frames.body: An original design language: the interface pre-resolves to the most probable outcome before the user consciously acts. It grew into GRAVITY, a spatial-physics paradigm for enterprise UI.

frames.title: AI-Augmented Ops
frames.body: A library of reusable AI skills covering UX strategy, design-system guidance and content strategy — built to compress research and documentation cycles for the teams I lead.

frames.title: 3-in-a-Box Governance
frames.body: PM, engineering and design deciding together against one written set of agreements. Established at IBM; first-pass design approvals up 35%.

works.footnote: Founder & Design Lead, DigitalFirstDevotional — a consumer mobile product on Next.js & Supabase, with AI-assisted personalisation end to end.

ai.heading: How I put AI to work.
ai.lede: One or two sentences on what AI-augmented practice means on your teams — the outcome you're buying, not the tools you use.
